title: Concurrent export leader election and fork-proof invoice line generation
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem: Intermittent duplicated or missing invoice line items are produced when the billing export job is run concurrently across multiple workers after failover or transient errors. Root cause analysis shows overlapping worker windows, non-deterministic sort of usage deltas, and weak idempotency keys allowing competing exports to create forked invoice lines. Impact: customer invoices show double charges or missing proration adjustments during mid-cycle plan changes. Goal: make the export pipeline resilient to concurrent execution and ensure deterministic, fork-proof invoice-line generation with safe backfill and automated remediation.
design_summary: We will implement a leader election + lease model for export windows combined with deterministic delta sorting and a signed export fingerprint. Components: 1) Lease: a short-lived leader lease stored in Spanner with renewals; if lease lost, worker aborts export for that window. 2) Idempotency: generate an invoice-line id by hashing (customer_id, period_start, period_end, sorted usage_keys, export_version). 3) Deterministic ordering: canonical sort for usage deltas (by meter id, timestamp, sequence) to avoid non-deterministic aggregations. 4) Export signature: attach signed checksum and monotonic sequence to export file so downstream reconciler can detect forks and auto-quarantine. 5) Backfill safety: support a safe retry path that marks old conflicting exports as superseded and issues corrective adjustments rather than blind deletes. Trade-offs: leader lease introduces single-writer per-window; short leases keep throughput but add latency at exact boundary; deterministic sort increases CPU but removes rare duplicates.
test_plan: Unit tests for idempotency key generation and ordering. Integration tests running concurrent exporters in CI that attempt races (N=3 workers) asserting a single export commit. Staging run against 30k customer dataset to validate no orphaned lines. Canary: enable new export leader election for 10% of accounts for one billing cycle and monitor anomalies. Metrics to validate: duplicate_invoice_line_rate, export_lock_contention_rate, reconciliation_corrections_count, exports_per_minute. Rollback path: revert new leader election and allow reconciliation job to quarantine and emit corrective credits.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): implement leader election and deterministic id generation behind feature flag. Phase 2 (canary): enable for 10% accounts for one cycle and compare reconciliation corrections to baseline. Phase 3 (global): enable for all accounts and retire legacy fallback path after two clean billing cycles. Schedule migrations during low-traffic hours and ensure export job has a compatibility switch to operate in legacy mode if an unexpected farm-wide failure occurs.
comments: 2026-01-18 - Ava Chen: Created ticket after postmortem for invoice duplication incident on 2026-01-12. Included initial RCA and proposed leader election approach.

2026-01-22 - Diego Ramos: Spike complete. Verified Spanner lease approach vs Redis: Spanner preferred for transactional semantics and cross-region durability. Performance tests show ~2% CPU overhead on exporter worker under 1000 accounts.

2026-01-28 - Engineering review: Agreed on deterministic idempotency and export signature. Requested explicit schema for export fingerprint. Action: add deterministic sort by (meter_path, bucket_start_ts, event_seq).

2026-02-02 - QA: Integration test harness added that simulates 3 concurrent exporters. Observed 0 duplicates in 1000 runs when lease renewals set to 30s. Added edge-case test for worker crash after commit—ensured reconciler detects incomplete exports.

2026-02-04 - Diego Ramos: Feature-flagged implementation landed in staging branch (PR #4882). Next: run canary for 10% of accounts and monitor dashboards for a billing cycle. TODO: coordinate with SRE for database lease monitoring alerts.
